quests.title: Fill one row
quests.ask: Write `fill_row()`: put a gem on every cell of the grid's top row, ending just past its east end, still facing east.
quests.nudge: Which two things happen on every cell? Those belong inside the loop.

quests.title: Back to the start, one down
quests.ask: Write `next_row()`: from just past the end of a row, get to the west end of the row below, facing east, ready to fill it.
quests.nudge: Where does `fill_row()` begin? That's exactly where `next_row()` has to leave the robot.

quests.title: Two rows, stacked
quests.ask: Fill the top row, move to the next one and fill that too.
quests.nudge: If the second row goes wrong, look at where the robot is when it starts it.

quests.title: The whole grid
quests.ask: Repeat the pair of calls to fill every row, and finish below the grid on the west side.
